name: Milpitas Volunteer Program (teen-friendly roles)
org: City of Milpitas Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Join the city's volunteer list. Each month you get an email with jobs to pick from: city events, park cleanups, theater crew, tutoring at the Teen Center, or history fun at the old Alviso Adobe.
who_can_apply: All ages. Volunteers under 14 need a parent or adult with them. Some jobs have their own rules. Volunteers 18 and older need fingerprint clearance for some jobs.
duration: Ongoing. Some jobs are one day, others are longer projects.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer form. You do not need a form for park cleanups. Call 408-586-3210 or email volunteers@milpitas.gov with questions.
notes: The Alviso Adobe likes high school helpers, but most tours are on school day mornings. Teen Center tutoring is on weekdays from 4 to 7 pm. The page's list of events and cleanups looks old (the last cleanup shown is from January 2024). Watch the monthly emails for new ones.
